site.desc: Paste an Instagram video, photo, Reel, Story or IGTV link, pick a format and save it to your device. No sign-up, fast and simple.

hero.lead: Save publicly available Instagram content to your device. No account or password needed.
url.label: Link you want to download
how.title: How it works
how.s1: In Instagram, open the ⋯ menu of a post, Reel or story and choose “Copy link”.
how.s2: Paste the link into the box and press “Download”.
how.s3: The file downloads by itself when it’s ready. Files are deleted from the server after 15 minutes.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes. No account or payment is needed.
faq.a2: Most links to public posts, Reels, IGTV videos and stories. Private accounts and content that requires a login can’t be downloaded, and Instagram may block some content.
faq.q3: Do I need to give my Instagram password?
faq.a3: No. getliyo never asks for your Instagram password or account details. If you are ever asked for them, don’t use it.
faq.a4: Prepared files are deleted automatically from the server within 15 minutes, and you can delete them yourself at any time.
faq.a5: No. Only download your own content or public content you have permission to use. Copyright and redistribution are your responsibility.
faq.q6: How do I report a copyright violation?
faq.a6: Write to the address on the Copyright / DMCA page.
